common.error: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
common.staleButton: This button is no longer active
common.busy: Another bot dialog is already open. Finish it and try again.

menu.title: ServerCore
menu.subtitle: server access
menu.hint: Linking goes through a personal link from the game: join the server and the link shows up in game chat.

start.badTokenBody: The linking code is damaged or has already been used.
start.badTokenHint: Rejoin the server — a fresh personal link will appear in game chat.

account.title: My account
account.notLinkedHint: To play on the server, link your account: join the server and a personal link will appear in game chat.

link.confirmAside: Only this Telegram account will be able to confirm logins and manage the account.
link.progress: Checking that you are in game on this account…
link.nudge: Press Confirm or Cancel under the message above.
link.cancelledBody: The link is still valid — resume later with /start.
link.successAside: This Telegram account now confirms server logins and manages the account.

fail.token: The linking code is invalid or has already been used. Rejoin the server — a fresh link will appear in game chat.
fail.frozen: The account is banned or frozen. Contact the server administration if this is a mistake.
fail.alreadyLinked: This Minecraft account is already linked to another Telegram account, or this Telegram account already belongs to someone else.
fail.ownership: Could not confirm that you are in game on this nickname. Join the server and open the link from game chat without leaving the server.
fail.offline: The server is unreachable right now, so ownership cannot be confirmed. Try again later.
fail.rateLimited: Too many linking attempts. Wait a couple of minutes.
fail.notFound: Account not found. Rejoin the server and use a fresh link from game chat.

deletion.confirmBody: Minecraft access will be revoked, you will leave the Telegram group, and the account data will be anonymized. This cannot be undone.
deletion.doneAside: Server access revoked, Telegram link removed, data anonymized.
deletion.failBody: Some access-revocation steps failed — the account is pending deletion. Try again later or contact the administration.
deletion.nudge: Press Delete or Cancel under the message above.

app.answerEmpty: The answer is empty — write something.
app.answerTooLong: The answer is longer than {{max}} characters — shorten it.
app.answerNonText: Send your answer as a text message.
app.commandHint: Commands are off while the application is open. Answer with text or press Cancel.
app.buttonHint: Use the buttons under the summary: Submit application or Cancel.
app.alreadyInProgress: An application is already open — keep answering or press Cancel.
app.summaryAside: Once submitted, the application goes to a vote in the closed group — the result arrives here.
app.submittedBody: The members' vote runs in the closed group. The result will arrive here.
app.blockedLiveBody: A second one cannot be submitted. The result will arrive here once the vote ends.
app.blockedStatusBody: The account is not in the right state. If this is a mistake, contact the administration.
app.blockedCooldownBody: Three months have not passed since the last application. The next one opens on {{date}} ({{tz}}).
app.notLinkedBody: An application comes from a linked account. Join the server — a personal link will appear in game chat.
app.notFoundBody: Join the server and register via the link in game chat.
app.rateLimitedBody: Wait a couple of minutes and try again.

lang.savedBody: The bot will keep talking in this language.
lang.noAccount: Link an account first — the language is stored on it. Join the server and the link will arrive in game chat.

help.title: Help
help.commands:
/status — server and account status
/application — fill in the application
/myapplication — your latest application
/language — interface language
/cancel — cancel the open application
/help — this help
help.aside: Registration starts in game: join the server and a personal link will appear in chat.

stats.title: Stats
stats.unavailable: Stats unavailable: the database is not connected.

auth.title: Server login
auth.detected: A new game session is waiting for confirmation.
auth.window: The request is valid for another {{seconds}} s.
auth.info: The request is tied to the current session and is single-use. If this was not you, reject the login: the account stays in guest mode and nobody gets access.
auth.rejected: Login rejected — the player stays in guest mode.
auth.alreadyProcessed: This request has already been handled.
auth.expired: The request expired — rejoin the server.
auth.notYours: This request belongs to another account.
auth.unknown: The request was not found or is out of date.
auth.noActiveSession: No active game session — nothing to confirm.
auth.staleSession: The session changed, the request is out of date. Rejoin the server.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a couple of minutes.
